questions.question: How does the afflicted psalmist describe his days in Psalm 102?
options: They flow on like a river
They stand firm like the hills
They shine forth like the sun

questions.question: What contrast does the psalm make about God?
options: The raging nations will rise up, but God only laughs from his throne in heaven
The heavens will perish, but God remains the same and his years have no end
The righteous ones will suffer awhile, but God will surely reward them at last
The wicked may prosper for a time, but God will certainly judge them in the end
questions.answer: The heavens will perish, but God remains the same and his years have no end

questions.question: The psalm is titled a prayer of one afflicted, pouring out his complaint before the LORD.
But you, O LORD, are enthroned forever; you are remembered throughout all _____.
He will regard the prayer of the _____ and will not despise their prayer.
